file_id: Thummalapenta Pradeep Kumar vs State Of Ap on 18 July, 2019

sentences.text:
Thummalapenta Pradeep Kumar vs State Of Ap on 18 July, 2019
 Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu

entities.text: Thummalapenta Pradeep Kumar vs State Of Ap
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash the proceedings against the petitioner-A.8 in Crime No.215 of 2019 of Lalapet Police Station, Guntur Urban, registered for the offences under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328, 420 IPC and Sections 58 & 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
3.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 4. In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.215 of 2019 of Lalapet Police Station, Guntur Urban, registered for the offences under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328, 420 IPC and Sections 58 & 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, the Miscellaneous Applications, if any pending shall stand closed.

D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 12.7.2019 YS Thummalapenta Pradeep Kumar vs State Of Ap on 18 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30044393/
